model.title: Chugach Alaska Land Exchange Oil Spill Recovery Act of 2025
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Lisa Murkowski (R-AK)

summary.text: The bill would authorize a land exchange in Alaska between the Chugach Alaska Corporation, an Alaska Native regional corporation, and the federal government. If Chugach transfers approximately 231,000 acres of subsurface rights to the Department of the Interior within a year, the federal government would transfer approximately 65,374 acres of land in the Chugach region (on the Kenai Peninsula and near Prince William Sound) to Chugach in return, with certain village corporation lands and shareholder homesites excluded from the exchange.
